No -Command/-EncodedCommand, shell expression, extra arguments, alternate executable or execution-policy bypass. Reuse original SPEC/wrapper; no new runner.

This is hidden non-Godot containment, not a new guard mode. Never lower thresholds or modify guard/policy/pins.

Candidate WordsAndPerils.NativeGuardFocusedGuiCandidate.Guard.Run, candidate wrapper and candidate Win32/runtime protection tests are forbidden. No Godot executable, engine help/version, Main/editor/GUI/capture, service, model/network request or deployment. Missing existing compiler/guardian or genuine rejection means stop/blocked, not another route.

Capture actual parent guardian PID/creation time, guarded PowerShell child RootPid/creation time, owner runID, lock, start/end and every parent/guardian/child exit. Require original schema wordsandperils_windows_native_guard/v3, Started=true, WorkloadResumed=true, JobAssignedBeforeResume=true, EngineStarted=false, EnvironmentInherited=false, exact Job limit/readback/kill/breakaway/affinity/priority, GuardExitCode=RootExitCode=parent_host_exit=0, JobEmptyAfterRun/AllRecordedHandlesExited/OutputReadersFinished=true and no SyntheticFault/output overflow. Success is compilation/managed validation, not candidate native protection equivalence or GUI run permission.

Verify child TEMP/TMP/APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA are supplied by original SHA-fixed ChildEnvironment under fresh guardian data, without inherited private environment. Run at most one new guarded PowerShell child under this task. Actual Add-Type/managed/guardian failure stops; no same-ID retry, source/catch/assertion edits or added guard self-tests. Existing v3 guardian is protection infrastructure, not a new candidate equivalence experiment. No engine invocation and no repetition of task010 gameplay tests.

Publish only new task candidate_root and exact result_root with existing two-phase fresh-main single-parent force=false CAS and exact remote byte/hash readback.
